Subject: 6-year tenure track position in biomathematics
 
Hello all,

The Institute of Mathematics in our department is hiring a tenure-track faculty member, with a 6-year window to complete tenure.  Our institutes work closely together, so plenty of opportunities for collaboration on applied wildlife topics.  Please forward to people that might be interested, and feel free to contact me with questions.

Here is a link to the announcement:  https://boku.ac.at/fileadmin/data/H01000/mitteilungsblatt/MB_2023_24/MB27/KZ192_LBSe.pdf

Closing date for applications is on October 8th.

All the best,
Brady
